prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofing company for every homeowner in Dallas — the right contractor depends on your needs (roof type, budget, timing, whether you’re filing an insurance claim, etc.). I can, however, tell you how to identify the best roofer for your specific project and what to ask so you can pick a reliable local company.

How to find the best roofer for your Dallas roof replacement
- Get at least 3 written estimates so you can compare scope, materials, and price.
- Verify insurance and bonding: ask for a copy of their general liability insurance and workers’ compensation (or proof they carry waivers for subcontractors).
- Check local reputation: read recent Google reviews, Yelp, BBB, Angi, and Nextdoor; ask for 3 local references and call them.
- Confirm manufacturer certifications: look for GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT, Owens Corning Preferred, etc. Certified contractors can offer better material warranties.
- Confirm permits & code compliance: the contractor should pull required City of Dallas permits and handle inspections.
- Warranty details: get both the manufacturer’s shingle warranty and a written workmanship warranty from the contractor (length and what it covers).
- Ask about scope & materials: tear-off vs overlay, number of shingles per square, underlayment type, ventilation (ridge vents/soffit), flashing, ice/water shield in valleys and eaves, drip edge, and whether they’ll replace rotten decking.
- Verify cleanup and disposal plans: dumpster on-site, daily cleanup, final inspection.
- Payment terms: avoid large upfront payments (common is 10–30% deposit), get all payments and milestones in writing.
- Red flags: high-pressure sales tactics, unmarked trucks, no physical address, only accepts cash, asking you to sign over insurance checks.

Important questions to ask every contractor
- Are you licensed/registered to work in Dallas? (ask for registration number if applicable)
- Are you insured? Can I see certificates?
- Are you a certified installer for the shingle brand you plan to use?
- Will you pull permits and coordinate inspections?
- What is your start and completion timeline?
- What does your workmanship warranty cover and for how long?
- Can you provide local references and pictures of recent jobs?
- What is included in the written estimate?

Where to look for candidates
- Google/Map reviews and Yelp
- Better Business Bureau
- Angi or HomeAdvisor
- Local Facebook groups or Nextdoor for neighborhood referrals
- Manufacturer locator pages (GAF/CertainTeed/Owens Corning “find a pro”)

If you want specific names
Tell me your Dallas ZIP code (or neighborhood) and whether this is an insurance claim or private pay. I can then list several highly rated local roofers and what to look for in their bids.
